# Rooms

Investigators start in the Warehouse, outside E.M. Gemovich's mind.
The investigators will move into her mind via the door carved in her forehead.

There are five types of rooms in the mind.

- Short story: 
  - The first room after the warehouse.
  - Leads to a memory
  - 2 exist (straight)
  - Becomes a lapse after 3 runs
- Memory
  - Leads to a lapse
  - 2 exits straight
  - Becomes a lapse after 1 run
- Lapse
  - Leads to a happy place
  - 2 exits straight
  - Each lapse can only give 1 reclamation/forfeit (unticked/ticked)
- Happy place
  - Four exits
  - 1st new exit leads to Novel
  - 2nd and 3rd new exits lead to 
  - Never becomes a lapse


- Short story

## Layout of rooms

The first room when entering E.M. Gemovich's mind is a random Short story.

The order of rooms is:

Short story -> Memory -> Lapse -> Happy place -> Novel

Short stories, memories, and lapses have 2 exits that are opposite from each other (one is used to enter the location initially).

Happy places have 4 exits, one on each side.

Novel rooms have 1 exit (used to enter the location from a happy place).

Happy places go to a novel room first but their other 2 leftover exits lead to random short story locations.

Short story, Memory, and lapses

## End of run

At the end of run the layout/rooms remain with the following changes:

Scribble out complete rooms, they become unticked lapses (retaining the number of exits they have).

- Short stories are complete once their ending has occurred (3 ticks)
- Memories are complete after the 2nd run they have been encountered (2 ticks)
- Happy place are complete after they have been entered in 5 runs (5 ticks)
- Novels are complete after the first run they have been entered (1 tick)

## Determining the room

When moving to an empty space roll a d6 and add the number of rooms present to determine the type of room encountered:

- 1-5: Short story
- 6-9: Memoir
- 10+: Novel

Then roll to determine the specific room:

| d6 | Short story (1-4) | Memoir (5-8) | Reclamation (1st 9+) | Novel (2nd 9+) |
|---------------|---------------|---------------|---------------|---------------|
| 1 | [S1: Foie gras](/the_taker_of_thoughts/s1_foie_gras.qmd) |  |  |  |
| 2 | [S2: San-nakji](/the_taker_of_thoughts/s2_san-nakji.qmd) |  |  |  |
| 3 | S3: Shark fin soup |  |  |  |
| 4 | S5: Hide glue |  |  |  |
| 5 | S4: Kopi luwak |  |  |  |
| 6 |  |  |  |  |

## Fifth room

Do not roll on the table for the fifth room of each run, instead a memory lapse occurs. 
Put down an empty locations and roll for the sixth location.
Investigators instantly move past the laps onto the sixth location.

## Fixed state of mind

Once a novel room appears no new rooms can appear in the current run.
